title: Cradle of the Hosts
description: A world that feels alive, where the player is only a part.
body:
![Cradle of the hosts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6463071dcaa7fea533569ca367175c77c065b43.png)
_A world that feels alive, where the player is only a part._

![-+-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/829fa6f28cdf2eb43c541b195ddf9238a7eded16.png)
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/VJUV-0v4vDE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Have you ever been bothered that a lot of structures and mobs seem to have no life or purpose other than being a tool for the player? 
I have, and this modpack fixes that.

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95daea563a94c2ed22420d6de374fbd70f7852a3.png)

- 🏔️Overhauled Overworld with [No Man's Land](https://modrinth.com/project/kjZCvAn6), [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/project/rex9wwpz) and [Galosphere](https://modrinth.com/project/Kn7xyQ1v).
- 🔥Improved Nether with [Nightosphere](https://modrinth.com/project/tdv7lfX5), [Hearths](https://modrinth.com/project/XCIMrYn0), [Skyborn Piglins](https://modrinth.com/project/bOllHHtA), [Nether's Exoticisim](https://modrinth.com/project/3e4LaIlU) and [Nether Descent](https://modrinth.com/project/OMC5QQv5)
- 🪐Overhauled end with [The Beyond](https://modrinth.com/project/QFR0NFEH) and [Endhanced End](https://modrinth.com/project/kJix7Q1N).
- 🔨Build anything with [Create](https://modrinth.com/project/LNytGWDc) and [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/project/oWaK0Q19).
- 🐸Intelligent feeling mobs with [Ribbits](https://modrinth.com/project/8YcE8y4T), [Mowzie's Mobs](https://modrinth.com/project/BFbX9xcm), and [One Big Eye](https://modrinth.com/project/glOKSBuK) to name a few.
- 📖Organized exploration with [Field Guide](https://modrinth.com/project/72RRCWM6) and [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/project/NcUtCpym).
- 🏰More structures with [Archeological](https://modrinth.com/project/z24qKJXQ), [Towns and Towers](https://modrinth.com/project/DjLobEOy) and [Explorify](https://modrinth.com/project/HSfsxuTo).
- 👀And so much more! (select a [version](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cradle-of-the-hosts/changelog) to see a full mod list)

![-+-](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/829fa6f28cdf2eb43c541b195ddf9238a7eded16.png)

- 📺Subscribe to my [youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@Whisdan)!


<details>
<summary>🔧Troubleshooting and Known Bugs</summary>
Allocate more memory to the instance and close all other programs you don't need running.

</details>
